data_description.model: Choose a published SaySo model (downloaded and checksum-verified) or a .gguf file in /config/sayso/models; you can also type a path.
data_description.grammar_decoding: Constrains model output to the tool-call syntax SaySo parses, so malformed calls are not generated. Applies only when Home Assistant tools are sent. Experimental; off by default.
data_description.duck_volume: Media players in the satellite's area are lowered to this volume while it listens. Players without a volume level are paused if playing, otherwise muted.
